versions.description: Win back players who were away. When a player connects after being away for at least minDaysAway days (from Takaro's last-seen time), they get a one-time welcome-back reward: currency and optional items, scaled by how long they were gone (tiers such as 7, 30 and 90 days). They get a private message, and optionally the server sees a broadcast. Each absence pays out once. Brand-new players are skipped, the first join belongs to onboarding. The WELCOME_BACK_CLAIM permission gates the reward; its count multiplies the currency for VIPs. Admins run welcomebackstats to see how many players came back each week.

commands.name: welcomebackstats
commands.description: Show how many players came back after being away, per week.
commands.helpText: Shows how many players returned (and got a reward) per week. Optional: number of weeks to show (1-26).

hooks.name: welcome-back
hooks.description: Gives the welcome-back reward when a player returns after being away.

functions.name: welcome-back-helpers

permissions.description: Player gets the welcome-back reward after being away. The count multiplies the currency reward (e.g. 2 for VIP doubles it). Give it to the Player role for everyone.
Allows an admin to see how many players returned per week.
